# CMS Provider Data Catalog: dialysis facilities + nursing homes, Georgia

- **Source URL(s):** Dialysis Facility - Listing by Facility (23ew-n7w9): https://data.cms.gov/provider-data/sites/default/files/resources/c04d84bc5c641284494bee4f20f17f9c_1781625941/DFC_FACILITY.csv ; Nursing Home Provider Information (4pq5-n9py): https://data.cms.gov/provider-data/sites/default/files/resources/4b708f7ece9ed1ef3060686c5546ddf1_1790792149/NH_ProviderInfo_Sep2026_3.csv ; metadata: https://data.cms.gov/provider-data/api/1/metastore/schemas/dataset/items/<id>
- **Fetched:** 2026-10-27
- **Publisher update date:** Dialysis modified 2026-06-16; nursing homes modified 2026-09-30
- **License / terms:** U.S. Government work (CMS). The metastore 'license' field is empty for both datasets, and no dataset-specific license text was found.
- **Terms URL:** https://data.cms.gov/provider-data/
- **Attribution:** Source: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, Provider Data Catalog (data.cms.gov), accessed 2026-10-27
- **Coverage:** GA rows only: 355 dialysis facilities, 356 nursing homes
- **Public repo + video safe?** Yes

## Notes

- Nursing homes include Latitude/Longitude (all 356 non-null). Dialysis has address/city/ZIP/county only, with no coordinates, so it needs geocoding (e.g. Census geocoder).
